facts.fact: ARTAC announced on 26 September 2026 that its fourth extraordinary Conference of Regulators will be held in Libreville on 20-21 October 2026, hosted by Gabon's regulator ARCEP, which is among the member regulators of ARTAC (a forward notice; the session had not yet taken place).
facts.system: Assembly of Telecommunications Regulators of Central Africa (ARTAC)
